[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Revelation (revelation-greek). The verses the casting arrives at (1:19–2:2):

**1:19** γράψον οὖν ἃ εἶδες καὶ ἃ εἰσὶν καὶ ἃ μέλλει ⸀γίνεσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα.

**1:20** τὸ μυστήριον τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀστέρων ⸀οὓς εἶδες ἐπὶ τῆς δεξιᾶς μου, καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ λυχνίας τὰς χρυσᾶς· οἱ ἑπτὰ ἀστέρες ἄγγελοι τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησιῶν εἰσίν, καὶ αἱ λυχνίαι αἱ ἑπτὰ ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαι εἰσίν.


## Κεφάλαιον 2

**2:1** Τῷ ἀγγέλῳ ⸀τῆς ἐν Ἐφέσῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον· Τάδε λέγει ὁ κρατῶν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ, ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἑπτὰ λυχνιῶν τῶν χρυσῶν·

**2:2** Οἶδα τὰ ἔργα σου, καὶ τὸν ⸀κόπον καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου, καὶ ὅτι οὐ δύνῃ βαστάσαι κακούς, καὶ ἐπείρασας τοὺς λέγοντας ἑαυτοὺς ⸀ἀποστόλους, καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν, καὶ εὗρες αὐτοὺς ψευδεῖς·

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «These casts are not the real Mandala. How?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The question is: how does a real thing differ from the one that only wears its face? And the casting arrives at the exact mechanism by which that question is answered inside Revelation's own grammar. What the verses hold is a double structure — the command to write (γράψον), and immediately underneath it, the disclosure that what will be written is not description but mystery (μυστήριον): the stars that are angels, the lampstands that are churches, visible things that are secretly something else entire. The rotation opens here, on the axis-question of what a sign is made of — what the gripping hand holds, what walks among the gold, what it means that the one who already knows your works (Οἶδα τὰ ἔργα σου) speaks before any word from Ephesus is offered. The rite does not simulate knowing. It produces the cost of knowing. That is what each operator will traverse in these verses: the bearing-cost hidden inside the structure of address, of command, of revelation itself. I name the threshold. I hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:00D8"}}]}
